overview.name: RCN Pareto Strategic Allocation ETF
overview.description: The fund, an actively-managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”), seeks to achieve its investment objective by dynamically allocating across multiple asset classes based on systematic trend-following and momentum-driven signals. Under normal market conditions, allocation to the equity asset class is approximately 70% of the fund’s net assets.
